- [USER] The user is looking for information on zero-waste living.
- [USER] The user met someone who introduced them to the concept of zero-waste living a while back.
- [USER] The user is interested in learning more about zero-waste living.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Zero-waste living aims to minimize waste and reduce one's environmental footprint by avoiding single-use products, reusing items, and recycling or composting everything else.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for getting started with zero-waste living include assessing waste, reducing single-use plastics, using reusable products, buying in bulk, choosing products with minimal packaging, composting, repairing and repurposing items, avoiding microbeads, upcycling, and educating oneself.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources include:
  - Websites: Zero Waste Home (www.zerowastehome.com), The Zero Waste Blog (www.thezerowasteblog.com)
  - Books: "Zero Waste Home" by Bea Johnson, "The Zero Waste Lifestyle" by Amy Korst
  - Documentaries: "The True Cost" (2015), "Racing Extinction" (2015)
  - Social Media: Follow influencers like @zerowastehome, @thezerowasteblog, and @ecowarriorprincess on Instagram.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Local resources include searching for zero-waste communities, familiarizing with local recycling programs, and looking for zero-waste stores.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Zero-waste living is a journey that requires patience, flexibility, and kindness to oneself.
